user.title: Gungor Customizations
user.description: Adds the presets and Immich settings to Configure. Wrappers stay in YAML.

light_default.title: Light · default
light_default.description: A single press turns this on; a program's set rule returns to it. An empty field is not applied.{error}

data_description.templates: Optional. A template here wins over the field above, e.g. brightness_pct: "{{ 30 if is_state('sun.sun','below_horizon') else 100 }}".

light_dim.title: Light · dim
light_dim.description: Double press: carries only the brightness. An empty field is not applied.{error}

data_description.templates: Optional. A template here wins over the field above, e.g. brightness_pct: "{{ 30 if is_state('sun.sun','below_horizon') else 100 }}".

light_night.title: Light · night
light_night.description: Hold: carries only the colour. An empty field is not applied.{error}

data_description.templates: Optional. A template here wins over the field above, e.g. brightness_pct: "{{ 30 if is_state('sun.sun','below_horizon') else 100 }}".

climate_default.title: Climate · default
climate_default.description: A program's set rule returns to this. An empty field is not applied.{error}

data_description.templates: Optional. A template here wins over the field above, e.g. brightness_pct: "{{ 30 if is_state('sun.sun','below_horizon') else 100 }}".

cover_default.title: Cover · default
cover_default.description: Applied at sunrise, sunset and when a program ends. An empty field is not applied.{error}

immich.title: Immich
immich.description: Empty address: Immich off. Key and password fields stay empty: leave them empty to keep the stored value, type a new one to replace it, '-' removes a user.{error}

data.scan_interval: Scan interval (0 = only the sync button)
data.share_albums: Share every album with the others

budget_thuis.title: Budget Thuis
budget_thuis.description: Electricity, gas and return delivery: the month so far as sensors (Energy dashboard). E-mail and password of the Budget Thuis app. The password shows empty: leave it empty to keep it. Empty e-mail: Budget Thuis off.

yaml_ignored.title: gungors: presets/Immich in YAML are ignored
yaml_ignored.description: They are set under Settings > Devices & services > gungors > Configure now. Remove {keys} from YAML.
